auth_test_tooltip: Probe the controller with the values entered above (does not save).
auth_test_missingFields: Please enter host and API token first.
auth_test_placeholder: The API token field still contains the masked placeholder. Clear the field completely and enter the full token again.
auth_test_error_tls: The certificate of the controller could not be verified (%s). Enter the CA certificate or switch off "Verify TLS certificate".
devices_empty: No devices yet — make sure the adapter is running and connected.
devices_error_load: Could not load devices. Is the adapter running?
actor_select_error: Could not load users. Is the adapter running?
actor_select_help: The selected user appears in UniFi Access logs and webhooks when ioBroker unlocks a door.
generic_webhook_server_not_running: The HTTP server of the adapter is not running at the moment, so this URL does not answer yet. Save the settings and check the log of the instance if it still does not start (port in use?).
generic_webhook_tls_inactive: TLS is enabled, but the certificates could not be loaded (%s). The built-in server is not started until this is fixed.
generic_webhook_public_base_unsaved: The public base URL in the form differs from the saved one. The URL shown follows the form; save the settings to apply it.
adapter_not_running: The adapter instance is not running. Start it and try again.
adapter_no_response: The adapter did not respond in time.
adapter_unknown_command: The running adapter instance does not know this request. Adapter and settings page seem to have different versions — restart the instance.
adapter_not_configured: The running instance has no controller host or API token yet. Enter both, save and try again.
